Scott Wapner

About the Author

Scott Wapner is the host of Fast Money: Halftime Report , which airs every weekday on CNBC. Wapner has also reported several documentaries for the network, including Ultimate Fighting: From Blood Sport to Big Time , which earned him an Emmy nomination, and One Nation, Overweight , for which he received an award from the Society of American Business Editors and Writers as well as a Sigma Delta Chi Award from the Society of Professional Journalists. Known industry-wide as an expert in the area of activism and markets, Wapner has reported live from the floor of the New York Stock Exchange and is in regular contact with all the personalities in When the Wolves Bite . He lives in New Jersey.

“I was kind of shell-shocked when it was over,” Wapner told Benzinga of The Brawl.

About the book

On January 25, 2013, activist investors Carl Icahn and Bill Ackman spent 27 minutes trading accusations and insults on live television, on a CNBC show hosted by Scott Wapner. The quarrel was over Herbalife, a maker of nutritional supplements: Ackman doubted its business model and Icahn backed it, and each held an opposing financial bet. Wapner traces how the clash grew into a feud lasting years, with shifting allegiances, lawsuits, secret deals, public accusations and billions of dollars in stock trades. Wapner had access to every player. Beyond the war of egos, he presents the saga as a cautionary tale about how much power, a decade after the financial crisis, still rests with a very few people.
